info.title: DCAA Pre-Award SF1408 Accounting System Auditor API
info.description: Audits a contractor's chart of accounts, indirect cost pool structure (Fringe, Overhead, G&A, B&P/IR&D), timekeeping procedures, labor distribution policy, and general ledger setup against the 18-point DCAA Standard Form 1408 (SF 1408) Pre-Award Accounting System Checklist, FAR 16.301-3, FAR Subpart 31.2, and DFARS 252.242-7006. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.summary: Audit DCAA Pre-Award SF 1408 Accounting System & Indirect Rates
post.description: Audits contractor chart of accounts, Fringe/Overhead/G&A indirect pools, timekeeping controls, and FAR 31.205 unallowables against the 18-point DCAA Standard Form 1408 (SF 1408) Pre-Award Checklist.

chart_of_accounts_and_pools_text.description: Contractor's chart of accounts, indirect cost pool structure (Fringe, Overhead, G&A, B&P/IR&D), timekeeping procedures, labor distribution policy, and general ledger setup.

target_contract_type_and_solicitation.description: Target contract type (CPFF, CPIF, CPAF, T&M, FFP) and solicitation SF 1408 / FAR 16.301-3 adequacy requirements.

accounting_software_and_erp_stack.description: Current accounting ERP & timekeeping stack (e.g., Deltek Costpoint, Unanet GovCon, QuickBooks + ICAT/BigTime, NetSuite).

example.chart_of_accounts_and_pools_text: General Ledger & Chart of Accounts: 5000-series Direct Costs (5100 Direct Labor, 5200 Subcontractors, 5300 ODCs/Travel); 6000-series Fringe Pool (Payroll Taxes, 401k Match, Health Insurance, PTO — allocated on Total Labor Dollars at 29.5%); 7000-series Engineering Overhead Pool (Indirect Technical Labor, Engineering Facilities, Cloud Dev Tools — allocated on Direct Labor + Direct Fringe at 24.0%); 8000-series G&A Pool (Executive, Accounting, Legal, BD, B&P — allocated on Total Cost Input [TCI] at 11.8%); 9000-series Unallowable Costs (9100 Interest, 9200 Entertainment, 9300 Non-Compliant Advertising). Timekeeping: Daily web timesheets with charge-code authorization, employee + supervisor electronic signoff, and audit trail.
